messages:

To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Harper Pulse Procurement <procurement@harperpulse.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement: PO requirements & discount eligibility

Hi David,

Hope you’re well. We’re moving forward with the Harper Pulse pilot and Procurement had a couple of asks before we can issue a PO:

- We need confirmation that the PO number will be printed on every invoice line and attached to the invoice metadata (our AP system requires a PO#, cost center, and GL tag).
- Payment terms: our standard is Net 60, but we understand Redwood publishes Net 30. Will you accept Net 45 or Net 60 under an enterprise agreement? Any impact to pricing/discounts?
- Invoice cadence: we typically prefer monthly invoices, but can do milestone invoices for SOW items — do you support split/milestone invoices?

I’ve attached our PO template for your routing (HarperPulse_PO_template.xlsx). If there’s a standard Redwood invoice sample that includes where you place PO metadata, can you send that?

Also, Procurement asked if there’s any pricing concession tied directly to providing a PO (e.g., small percentage off if we agree to PO + standard net terms).

Best,
Markus Bauer
Senior Procurement Manager
Harper Pulse Inc.

Attachment: HarperPulse_PO_template.xlsx (excel/xlsx, 18KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Markus Bauer <markus.bauer@harperpulse.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements & discount eligibility

Thanks Markus — appreciate the details and the PO template. Quick answers up front:

- PO on invoices: yes, we can ensure PO# is a top-level invoice field and include an invoice line with the PO number, cost center, and a GL tag. Finance requires a short mapping table (we’ll send a sample invoice with those fields populated).
- Net terms: our standard is Net 30. For enterprise agreements we can flex to Net 45 without price impact; Net 60 typically requires either a finance-approved exception or a small increase in price (or a commitment/prepay structure).
- Invoice cadence: we support monthly invoices, consolidated quarterly invoices, or milestone invoices for SOW-based work — flexible.

On discounts: we generally tie discounts to either committed spend (annual/12-month commits or prepay) or operational concessions (single consolidated invoice per quarter, or accepting a Net 45/Net 60 schedule). Example options we can offer for a deal your size:
  - 12% off list with 12-month prepay (single invoice, consolidated).
  - 7–8% off with 12-month annual commitment invoiced monthly.
  - 3–5% off for Net 45 with PO in place (depends on revenue band).

If you’d like, Vanessa (cc’d) can put a pricing sketch together that maps discount bands to PO/net terms/invoice cadence so Procurement can pick the preferred tradeoff. I’ll attach our current SOW and our SOC2 attestation for the review you might need.

Next step: if Procurement can confirm whether they want Net 45 with monthly invoices vs Net 60 with consolidated billing, we’ll draft the pricing lanes and the invoice sample.

Thanks,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 240KB), SOC2_Attestation.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

David — thanks for the quick response. A few follow-ups from Procurement:

- They’d prefer Net 60 if possible, but would consider Net 45 if there’s a modest discount.
- Is the prepay option available for a 12-month pilot commitment? We’d need to ship payment approvals internally, so prepay is possible but would require a higher discount to justify it.
- Could you share the sample invoice (with PO#, CostCenter, GL) and a redlined SOW example that highlights milestone vs usage billing? Procurement wants to see the format before issuing the formal PO.

Also, Procurement is asking if a single PO can be used with multiple invoice numbers (i.e., one PO that covers the year and multiple invoices against it).

Appreciate Vanessa helping with the pricing lanes — once we see the sample invoice we can move quickly.

—Markus

Hi Grace / David,

Forwarding the Harper Pulse thread — Procurement is asking about Net 60 vs Net 45 and whether we can provide a discount tied to accepting PO-centric billing and specific invoice cadence. Suggested lanes for approval (sketch):

1) Prepay option: 12-month prepaid, consolidated quarterly invoice — 12% off list. Requires one invoice (quarterly consolidated) and PO noted as reference.
2) Commitment option: 12-month term invoiced monthly — 8% off list. PO on each invoice, monthly cadence.
3) PO-only concession: No commitment, Net 45, monthly invoices — 4% off list. Net 60 only with finance exception or 2% price uplift.

Questions for finance: are the above discount bands within your approval thresholds? Also need confirmation on required invoice metadata (we plan to include fields: PO#, CostCenter, GL, ProjectCode). I’ve attached the SOW and the PO template from Harper Pulse for context.

Thanks — Vanessa
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HarperPulse_PO_template.xlsx (referenced), Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (referenced)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Procurement: PO requirements & discount eligibility — pricing lanes for finance approval

Vanessa / David — reviewed with Finance Ops. We can approve the following conditional concessions: 

- Option A (Approved): Net 45, PO on each invoice, monthly invoices — 8% discount. Condition: Harper Pulse must provide a single PO number per legal entity and include CostCenter + GL on each invoice line. Multiple invoice numbers against the same PO are acceptable provided the PO# is present on each invoice.

- Option B (Approved with higher control): 12-month prepay, consolidated quarterly invoice — 12% discount. Condition: prepayment must be received within 30 days of contract signature and we require a remittance address and internal AR contact for proof of payment. Finance will issue a single credit note if churn occurs mid-term.

- Net 60: we do not recommend as standard. Net 60 would require an additional 2% price premium unless Harper Pulse can provide a corporate guarantee or payment escrow arrangement.

Required invoice fields (exact spellings): PO#, CostCenter, GLCode, RedwoodProjectID. Sample invoice ID format: INV-RED-20250630-HP. Please have Sales include that sample in the packet to Procurement.

I’ll draft a short Finance approval note you can attach to the SOW for Procurement’s AP. Once Harper Pulse confirms which lane they prefer, David — please circulate the final SOW and the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
